verdict.reasons: The product family is classified as unknown because the packaging does not match the authoritative identity. The reference is a cylindrical roll on a core, while the candidate shows an oblate drum/spool shape, which is a core geometry defect. The branding text below 'AFP' is incoherent gibberish ('Dnp Irig...'), constituting a fake text defect. The commercial carton is integrated directly into the irrigation lateral line, which violates the requirement for separation. The installed evidence is highly implausible, showing a continuous pressure gauge standing in the soil with no supply pipe (only a thin lateral tape attached), rather than the required gauge on a continuous header with a separate take-off fitting. The drainage board in the bottom right corner is a minor layout warning.
